lifecycle: Compose visible UI between cui_begin_frame and cui_end_frame each frame. The context retains focus, resources and transient routing; explicit application models retain data, not an application widget tree.

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool expansion values and optional per-panel cui_disclosure_motion arrays.
components.interaction: Returns whether expansion changed; cui_disclosure_panel_fn composes panel children and cui_disclosure_header_fn custom headers.
components.usage: Submit stable item IDs and current expansion each frame; keep motion and style arrays alive through end_frame.
components.name: Accordion

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state and child form/application data.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: Initialize the appropriate surface kind, open from an action, and pair end only when begin succeeds. Consume result once.
components.name: AlertDialog

components.state_ownership: Caller optionally retains a bool visible flag referenced by cui_alert_options.visible.
components.interaction: Returns dismissal; writes supplied visibility.
components.usage: Submit the current title/message and visibility; handle dismissal in the returned event branch.
components.name: Alert

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_attachment_state and owns attachment model, metadata and resource lifetime.
components.interaction: cui_attachment_result reports actions; cui_attachment_action_fn receives remove/retry activation.
components.usage: Submit transfer status and progress; perform removal/retry in action callbacks, not render callbacks.
components.name: Attachment

components.state_ownership: Caller retains name, borrowed RGBA pixels, bounded circular cache and destination storage through rendering. Optional typed placeholder state and mask versions also survive draw completion; named SVG uses the context cache. Metrics and palettes are copied values.
components.interaction: Interactive avatars return activation; interactive stacks return the selected index or SIZE_MAX. Application opens the selected profile.
components.usage: Initialize a circular image cache once; submit borrowed image pixels with a revision. Missing/invalid images fall back to initials; stacks use stable application keys. Opt into shared design sizes, deterministic identity palettes or anonymous SVG placeholders without changing legacy defaults.
components.name: Avatar

components.state_ownership: Caller owns counts, badge options and child state; callbacks compose arbitrary child content synchronously.
components.interaction: Child controls return their own actions; corner indicators provide nonfocusable status semantics.
components.usage: Initialize options with cui_badge_defaults, select count/dot/icon and call cui_badge_ex with a content callback every frame.
components.name: Badge

components.state_ownership: Caller owns child data; no separate bubble model.
components.interaction: Child controls handle their own events.
components.usage: Begin the surface, compose child controls, then end it in the same frame.
components.name: Bubble

components.state_ownership: Caller owns application data; cui_button_options controls presentation.
components.interaction: Returns true on activation; invoke the application action in that branch.
components.usage: For Save, call save_document only when cui_button returns true. content is a composition callback, not an action handler.
components.name: Button

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool or cui_check_state value; context owns focus.
components.interaction: Returns true when the caller-owned value changes.
components.usage: Pass the current value by pointer and persist preferences in the change branch.
components.name: Checkbox

components.state_ownership: Host retains backend and application owns clipboard buffers; cui_platform carries portable callbacks.
components.interaction: Clipboard reads/writes are host interface calls, not a rendered widget action callback.
components.usage: Obtain the host clipboard interface and supply it to editing/copy controls; compose a Copy button to trigger application copying.
components.scope: host adapter facility; no standalone styled clipboard widget
components.name: Clipboard

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool expansion values and optional per-panel cui_disclosure_motion arrays.
components.interaction: Returns whether expansion changed; cui_disclosure_panel_fn composes panel children and cui_disclosure_header_fn custom headers.
components.usage: Submit stable item IDs and current expansion each frame; keep motion and style arrays alive through end_frame.
components.name: Collapsible

components.state_ownership: Caller retains menu tree state and menu entries.
components.interaction: cui_dropdown_button_result separates main action activation from menu interaction.
components.usage: Handle the primary action result separately from the adjacent menu trigger.
components.name: DropdownButton

components.state_ownership: Caller owns title and description.
components.interaction: Borrowed content callbacks can submit buttons and handle their activation events.
components.usage: Compose optional media/title/description header, content and appended children. Child callbacks submit ordinary native controls.
components.name: Empty

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_overlay with modal=true; context retains focus routing/restoration.
components.interaction: Overlay update handles dismissal/focus; child controls return their own events.
components.usage: Open a modal overlay, submit children inside its active scope and close via application actions.
components.name: Focus Trap

components.state_ownership: Caller owns title and child data; no group model.
components.interaction: Child controls handle their own events.
components.usage: Pair begin/end around application-composed children.
components.name: GroupBox

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_hover_state for delay/open lifecycle.
components.interaction: Hover, focus and escape update the open model. Optional synchronous observers report aggregate open-state transitions, independently of composition admission or actual visibility.
components.usage: Submit the trigger first. With event facades, inspect changed separately from control_result; end HoverCard only when control_result is true. Handlers are borrowed for the call and are not retained across delay or omission.
components.name: HoverCard

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_icon_state for custom SVG/resource preparation; named helper uses context resources.
components.interaction: cui_icon_loader_fn resolves SVG resources; no click callback.
components.usage: Initialize custom icon state, load data/name/path, submit each frame and destroy prepared resources after use.
components.name: Icon

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_image_state and owns loader/resource backing storage.
components.interaction: cui_image_loader_fn resolves resources; cui_image_result reports load status, not a click event.
components.usage: Submit a source and loader each frame; retain loaded frame resources for their documented paint lifetime.
components.name: Image

components.state_ownership: Caller owns shortcut text and optional formatting buffer.
components.interaction: Presentation only; shortcut dispatch belongs to the application.
components.usage: Submit typed single-stroke hints; compose several as ordinary row children. Host shortcut registration remains separate.
components.name: Kbd

components.state_ownership: Caller owns label text.
components.interaction: Optional semantic control association; presentation has no action callback.
components.usage: Compose secondary text, Unicode highlights and private scalar masking with cui_label_options; the plain wrapper remains available.
components.name: Label

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_marker_state and child descriptors; owns animation time.
components.interaction: cui_status_render_fn paints rich content; no action callback.
components.usage: Supply elapsed time/loading status and compose children using resolved style and opacity.
components.name: Marker

components.state_ownership: Caller owns message data and slot content.
components.interaction: cui_message_render_fn composes slots; action controls inside slots supply events.
components.usage: Submit body and slot options each frame; compose application actions in designated slots.
components.name: Message

components.state_ownership: Caller retains allocated cui_message_scroller_state and message data; destroy model after use.
components.interaction: Row render callbacks compose visible messages; optional cui_message_scroller_handler observes final double offsets and following-tail policy, offset before tail, after legacy composition.
components.usage: Retain state and records through frame completion. Use cui_message_scroller_events for aggregate applied notifications; explicit mutators stay result-only and returned change flags do not replay callbacks.
components.name: MessageScroller

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_notification_state, entry storage, notification content/user pointers and host binding.
components.interaction: cui_notification_callback handles click/close/action; cui_notification_send_fn delegates system delivery to host.
components.usage: Push on an application event, render the stack once after content each frame, and honor returned scheduling deadlines.
components.name: Notification

components.state_ownership: Caller retains size_t page.
components.interaction: Returns true when page changes.
components.usage: On a page change, load or select application data for the new page.
components.name: Pagination

components.state_ownership: Caller owns the target fraction, host clock and optional zero-initialized cui_progress_motion.
components.interaction: Presentation only; the extended return reports whether another animation frame is needed.
components.usage: Submit the controlled fraction each frame; use cui_progress_defaults for the source loading cycle and retain motion state for smooth value changes. Circles need caller-owned pixel storage retained through rendering.
components.name: Progress

components.state_ownership: For grouped choices, retain one selected cui_id and cui_radio_group_state per collection; standalone radios retain one shared integer.
components.interaction: cui_radio_group resolves controlled callback requests before painting and provides arrow/Home/End navigation with one Tab stop; standalone functions return true when selection changes.
components.usage: Submit stable unique item IDs to cui_radio_group; synchronously accept or reject on_change requests in your application model. Keep selected and navigation between frames.
components.name: Radio

components.state_ownership: Caller retains float rating.
components.interaction: Returns true when rating changes.
components.usage: Pass the current rating by pointer and save it in the change branch.
components.name: Rating

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_shimmer_state through end_frame and supplies elapsed time.
components.interaction: Presentation only; no action callback.
components.usage: Submit text, timing and reduced-motion preference; honor animation wake deadlines.
components.name: Shimmer

components.state_ownership: Caller owns elapsed time/phase and reduced-motion preference.
components.interaction: Presentation only; no action callback.
components.usage: Derive phase from elapsed time and schedule redraws while loading.
components.name: Skeleton

components.state_ownership: Caller owns persistent motion state, the monotonic host clock and reduced-motion preference.
components.interaction: Decorative presentation; paint/ease callbacks customize appearance and phase, with no action callback or implicit busy semantics.
components.usage: Submit cui_spinner_ex each frame while loading and schedule result.next_wake_seconds; zero deadline means idle. Use a custom paint callback for another SVG icon.
components.name: Spinner

components.state_ownership: Caller owns step descriptors and size_t active step.
components.interaction: Legacy reducer updates the active index; additive navigation requests let the application validate and choose the next submitted index.
components.usage: Submit step descriptors and the current step; validate application data before progressing elsewhere.
components.name: Stepper

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool value and optional cui_switch_state motion.
components.interaction: Returns activation/change; cui_boolean_change_fn receives requested value when on_change is set, leaving acceptance to the caller.
components.usage: Accept or reject requested changes in a synchronous on_change callback; resubmit the accepted value next frame.
components.name: Switch

components.state_ownership: Caller owns tag text/content; no tag model.
components.interaction: Presentation only; child controls provide actions.
components.usage: Use the text helper or pair successful begin/end and apply returned foreground/font style to children.
components.name: Tag

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool pressed value.
components.interaction: Returns activation/change; optional cui_boolean_change_fn receives the requested value.
components.usage: Keep the authoritative bool in application state; on_change may validate before accepting.
components.name: Toggle

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_hover_state for delay/open lifecycle.
components.interaction: Hover, focus and escape update the open model. Optional synchronous observers report aggregate open-state transitions, independently of composition admission or actual visibility.
components.usage: Submit the trigger first. With event facades, inspect changed separately from control_result; end HoverCard only when control_result is true. Handlers are borrowed for the call and are not retained across delay or omission.
components.name: Tooltip

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_calendar_state and cui_date_selection.
components.interaction: cui_calendar_result reports aggregate selection/navigation; live cui_date_disabled_fn excludes dates. Presentation and behavior extensions have no typed observer bridge or binding options; legacy CHANGE remains selection-only.
components.usage: Initialize caller state and submit each frame. Optional cui_calendar_ex enables month access, host-supplied today and neighboring cells; cui_calendar_with_behavior adds independent range transition, endpoint validation, year destination and recenter policies. Zero options preserve exact legacy behavior. Rebuild with matching headers/library.
components.name: Calendar

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_color_state and cui_color value. ColorEntry owns an address-stable, noncopyable bounded draft/editor; destroy after render consumption. Float-HSLA entry separately retains normalized full-precision selection/preview and an address-stable owned editor.
components.interaction: Returns true when color changes. Additive ColorEntry separates draft/preview/commit and summarizes accepted Enter commits after submission; owner sync is silent and conflict-aware. Float-HSLA entry preserves owner floats until explicit hex parsing; SELECT requests close without owning a popup.
components.usage: Submit persistent channel/editor state; use the accepted color in the next frame theme or preview.
components.name: ColorPicker

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit query/buffer, popup state, items, selection and filtered scratch array with capacity at least the item count.
components.interaction: cui_combobox_result distinguishes query and selection behavior.
components.usage: Retain the query editor and popup; filter application choices using the query and process returned changes.
components.name: Combobox

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_date_picker_state and cui_date_selection.
components.interaction: Returns final selection changes; live cui_date_disabled_fn restricts dates. The extended API forwards Calendar presentation/behavior and preserves final-queue completion close/focus; legacy CHANGE wrappers do not accept the extension or observe lifecycle.
components.usage: Initialize stable popup identity once; submit caller state and selection each frame. Optional cui_date_picker_ex forwards month/today/neighbor presentation and independent range/year/recenter policies. Zero extension preserves legacy behavior, including late-error bool; rebuild matching headers/library.
components.name: DatePicker

components.state_ownership: Application retains the multiline edit, visual-row workspace, editor/search state, matcher ranges, query/replacement edit models and optional replacement scratch. Multicursor editing also borrows live selections, history snapshots and cursor anchors; adapters borrow this storage.
components.interaction: cui_editor returns edit, selection and scroll results; retained search supports ASCII-insensitive navigation and atomic replacement. Optional multicursor interaction supports adding cursors, measured navigation, selection painting, atomic typing and undo/redo; cui_editor_highlight_fn supplies syntax colors.
components.usage: Initialize editor and optional search resources once, call cui_editor_find_bar every frame, and pass the same matcher in cui_editor_options.search for visible match highlights. Attach selection storage with cui_edit_attach_selections and initialize borrowed anchors with cui_editor_multicursor_init to enable multicursor interaction. Keep replacement scratch disjoint from model storage.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + retained base model
components.name: Editor

components.state_ownership: Caller owns field descriptors, labels, validation messages and each control value/model.
components.interaction: cui_form_content_fn composes field controls; those controls supply action/change events.
components.usage: Describe associations and validation in fields; submit controls in content callbacks and handle their events there.
components.name: Form

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit and its backing buffer; cui_input_ex additionally uses caller-owned cui_input_state.
components.interaction: cui_input_result reports changed, submitted, rejected and errors. Optional whole-value validate callback decides whether a proposed edit is accepted. Checked pattern and number formatting use caller-owned workspace and commit as one Undo step.
components.usage: Create an editor once; submit it each frame and perform application submission only on the result event.
components.name: Input

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit, cui_input_group_state, and addon descriptors.
components.interaction: cui_input_group_result reports edit behavior; cui_input_group_content_fn composes addons. Opt-in observers report accepted addon activations and per-event nested text changes/submissions; results never replay callbacks.
components.usage: Keep the editor and state across frames and compose prefix/suffix addon controls.
components.name: Input Group

components.state_ownership: Caller retains double value, cui_number_state and its borrowed cui_edit editor/buffer.
components.interaction: cui_number_result reports changed/submitted/invalid; cui_number_step_fn customizes stepping.
components.usage: Retain editor draft across frames; consume submitted/changed separately from invalid input.
components.name: NumberInput

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_otp_state and initialized character buffer.
components.interaction: cui_otp_result distinguishes changed and completion events.
components.usage: Initialize bounded storage once, submit cells each frame and consume the returned completion event.
components.name: OtpInput

components.state_ownership: Caller retains question definitions, state and all workspace buffers.
components.interaction: cui_questionnaire_event_fn emits model events; cui_questionnaire_validate_fn validates answers.
components.usage: Initialize definitions/workspace once; compose current controls each frame and handle answer/submit events. Optional masked slot styles refine boxes; six localized labels override defaults. Rebuild consumers after changing the by-value options ABI. Additive keyboard policies offer OFF/letters/numbers, item-only answer entry and host-selected Control/Meta submission; zero preserves legacy routing. Language builders omit these policies. Pure answer/submission snapshots copy effective values into caller-owned bounded storage without callbacks or model mutation; query_copy reports scalar state. Language builders omit snapshot APIs.
components.name: Questionnaire

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_choice_popup, selected cui_id and item array.
components.interaction: Returns selection change; choice content/render callbacks customize presentation.
components.usage: Initialize popup once; submit trigger and selected value each frame.
components.name: Select

components.state_ownership: Caller retains float value and supplies min/max/step.
components.interaction: Returns true when the value changes.
components.usage: Pass a volume value by pointer; apply audio settings only in the change branch.
components.name: Slider

components.state_ownership: Caller retains speech state/workspace and recognizer/input implementations.
components.interaction: cui_speech_event_fn reports recognition events; host reports queue messages and application pumps them.
components.usage: Initialize provider bindings, pump recognition on the owning thread and compose button/waveform each frame; dispose after use.
components.name: Speech

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit, buffer, cui_textarea_state and line workspace.
components.interaction: cui_textarea_result reports edit events and layout errors.
components.usage: Initialize line storage once and submit the multiline editor each frame.
components.name: Textarea

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_time_state and cui_time value.
components.interaction: Returns true when the time value changes.
components.usage: Submit segment state and time by pointer; persist accepted time in the change branch.
components.name: TimeField

components.state_ownership: Caller retains state, geometry workspace and slide data.
components.interaction: cui_carousel_change_fn observes selection; cui_carousel_render_fn composes slides.
components.usage: Initialize capacity once, submit slides each frame and handle selected-index changes separately from slide rendering.
components.name: Carousel

components.state_ownership: Caller owns item descriptors/content; no separate list model.
components.interaction: cui_description_render_fn composes custom values; child controls provide actions.
components.usage: Submit label/value descriptors each frame; respect the resolved layout width in custom content.
components.name: DescriptionList

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state and child form/application data.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: Initialize the appropriate surface kind, open from an action, and pair end only when begin succeeds. Consume result once.
components.name: Dialog

components.state_ownership: Application retains cui_dock, cui_dock_view and the panel registry; keep callback data alive through renderer completion.
components.interaction: Panel render callbacks compose active content; on_event reports select, close, reorder, move, split and resize; allow_operation may veto structural actions.
components.usage: Create the model and view once, register stable panel keys, submit cui_dock_view_render each frame and serialize the model between frames.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + retained base model
components.name: Dock

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_list_state, selected cui_id and item array.
components.interaction: Returns changes; cui_choice_activation_fn / cui_choice_confirm_fn / cui_choice_cancel_fn handle list interaction.
components.usage: Keep keys stable; submit current items and selection, then handle activation/confirmation callbacks synchronously.
components.name: List

components.state_ownership: Caller retains menu entries and popup/menu-tree state.
components.interaction: Returns activation and writes the activated cui_id through the action pointer; check/radio entries update caller values. cui_menu_render_fn composes custom content.
components.usage: Initialize menu-tree state once and submit stable entry IDs each frame; invoke application actions from the returned activation and action key.
components.name: Menu

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state and child form/application data.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: Initialize the appropriate surface kind, open from an action, and pair end only when begin succeeds. Consume result once.
components.name: Popover

components.state_ownership: Caller retains state, slots and panel descriptors.
components.interaction: cui_resizable_resize_fn observes size changes; panel content composes controls.
components.usage: Initialize slot storage, submit panel descriptors each frame and save sizes after resize events.
components.name: Resizable

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_root, plugin instance storage, registry and bound surface/notification storage.
components.interaction: cui_root_content_fn composes application content; cui_root_copy_fn handles copy; plugins have explicit lifecycle hooks.
components.usage: Initialize root/plugin storage, render content and facilities each frame, then dispose after use.
components.name: Root View

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_scroll_state offsets and supplies content/viewport dimensions.
components.interaction: Legacy begin/end reduce scroll input. Optional paired observers report one applied final offset after children and finish; normalization is not evidence of user input.
components.usage: Preserve caller offsets. Base observer begin may return false for a valid no-change pair and must still be finished. Styled observer begin returns admission: end only after true. Handlers are borrowed by finish/end; do not mix pairing layers.
components.name: Scrollable

components.state_ownership: Caller retains page state/workspace, descriptors and actual setting values.
components.interaction: cui_setting_render_fn composes controls; cui_setting_dirty_fn and cui_setting_reset_fn implement application dirty/reset behavior.
components.usage: Initialize page/query storage; submit descriptors and implement each setting through its render/dirty/reset functions.
components.name: Settings

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state and child form/application data.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: Initialize the appropriate surface kind, open from an action, and pair end only when begin succeeds. Consume result once.
components.name: Sheet

components.state_ownership: Caller retains sidebar state/cache, entry descriptors and selected application route.
components.interaction: cui_sidebar_content_fn composes regions; menu-item results expose selection/activation.
components.usage: Initialize measurement cache, submit current entries, and update routing from menu-item events.
components.name: Sidebar

components.state_ownership: Caller owns left/center/right descriptors and displayed data.
components.interaction: cui_chrome_render_fn composes regions; child controls handle actions.
components.usage: Submit region content each frame; preserve application data outside the bar.
components.name: StatusBar

components.state_ownership: Caller retains selected cui_id, item array and optional motion/scroll state.
components.interaction: Returns selection changes; cui_tab_panel_fn composes selected panel content.
components.usage: Submit tab descriptors and current selected key; keep optional animation state across frames.
components.name: Tabs

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_theme value and any icon-loader user/backing storage.
components.interaction: cui_theme_icon_loader_fn resolves icon SVG; theme selection is an application event.
components.usage: Choose/copy a preset and pass its address to styled controls; invalidate after changing it.
components.scope: application style data; passed during frame submission
components.name: Theme

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_title_bar_state and window interface binding.
components.interaction: on_close callback handles application close; window host functions implement native window behavior.
components.usage: Submit current window information each frame; keep host/user pointers valid during calls.
components.name: TitleBar

components.state_ownership: Caller owns item/command descriptors and command user data.
components.interaction: cui_toolbar_render_fn composes items; cui_toolbar_command.on_activate handles command activation.
components.usage: Submit command descriptors each frame and perform application actions in on_activate.
components.name: Toolbar

components.state_ownership: Caller retains model/state, selected cui_id and borrowed node/expansion arrays until next successful rebuild.
components.interaction: cui_tree_result separates selection_changed, expansion_changed and activated key.
components.usage: Rebuild preorder data when it changes; submit visible rows each frame and open the activated application item from the result.
components.name: Tree

components.state_ownership: Application retains cui_virtual_list and cui_virtual_widget_state; keyed extents live in the model and row controls remain application-owned.
components.interaction: cui_virtual_render_item_fn composes the visible window; cui_virtual_measure_item_fn supplies intrinsic measurement; optional cui_scroll_handler observes aggregate final offsets after composition, with UNKNOWN source.
components.usage: Rebuild keyed extents between frames and keep keys stable during row callbacks. Use cui_virtual_list_draw_events for final-offset observation; inspect changed separately from delivered change_count and the unchanged deferred control_result.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + retained base model
components.name: VirtualList

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_chart_state, its RGBA pixel buffer/byte capacity, data arrays and resources used by options.
components.interaction: Hit testing identifies data; tooltip/format/paint callbacks customize output and are not application action callbacks.
components.usage: Submit data/options each frame; route application actions from explicit hit testing or child controls.
components.name: Chart

components.state_ownership: Caller retains command state, row workspace, cui_edit query and command descriptors.
components.interaction: on_select/on_query/on_confirm/on_cancel observe synchronous interaction; command item action invokes application work.
components.usage: Initialize bounded query/row storage, submit entries each frame, and execute actions only from confirmation/action events.
components.name: Command

components.state_ownership: Caller retains allocated model/state, data rows/columns and any borrowed label storage.
components.interaction: cui_table_result reports interaction; cui_table_label_fn provides accessibility text and cui_table_cell_fn composes visible cells.
components.usage: Bind data when changed, submit virtual cells each frame, and handle selection/sort actions from the result.
components.name: DataTable

components.state_ownership: Caller retains scales, samples, path commands, RGBA pixels, tick labels and callback state; no retained widget tree.
components.interaction: cui_plot_activate_fn receives validated pointer positions; pure numeric operations return cui_plot_result and the application routes pan/zoom.
components.usage: Build paths and render into caller-owned pixels, then submit a themed bitmap and axes each frame; keep labels and pixels alive through renderer completion.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + standalone numeric model; bounded software rasterizer
components.name: Plot

components.state_ownership: Caller owns row/cell hierarchy and data; no retained table model is required.
components.interaction: Composition only; child controls handle actions.
components.usage: Submit sections, rows and cells using balanced begin/end nesting each frame.
components.name: Table

components.state_ownership: Caller retains state and all source/rendered/layout workspace buffers.
components.interaction: on_link/open_url handle link interaction; image resolves resources; other content/measurement hooks compose or paint.
components.usage: Initialize bounded workspace, set text on changes, then submit each frame. Decoded link URLs are borrowed only during callbacks: copy for deferred use.
components.name: TextView
